sources.title: WT Virtual Taekwondo Rules and Regulations (Version 4.0)
exact_claims_supported: Rules apply to WT-promoted and/or recognised Virtual Taekwondo competitions
Match format: best-of-3, 60-second rounds, 1-minute rest
Health Bar maximum 1000 HP; knockout at 0 HP
Draw criteria: headshots, then fewer kicks / higher damage per kick, then last hit
Scoring areas: above the waist and head; kicks deal damage; punches do not deal damage
Damage calculated from strike acceleration: Low, Medium, High; insufficient acceleration deals no damage
Stun: 500 stun points; 3-second immobilisation; kicks and punches fill stun bar; next successful strike stuns
Block via avatar forearm shields; successful block prevents damage and reduces opponent stun
Automatic break when avatars are close for 2 seconds
Court officials: Referee, Game Master, two Technical Operators; TD is ultimate technical decision-maker
GM creates room, starts match, checks calibration and virtual positions
TOs inspect nodes/headsets, assist calibration, monitor unnatural movement and equipment failure
AXIS sensors named in inspection procedure; VR headset with motion-tracking receiver
FOP: 4m x 4m mats, minimum 2m apart; two start-position options 1m from centre; display and safety distances
Calibration required before match and between rounds; Referee signals proper calibration
Disconnection: recoverable restore, or restart if within first 20 seconds, or leading-player assessment after 20 seconds
Technical timeout card once per coach per match; round reset if issue in first 10 seconds
Prohibited: manipulating PC/headset/controllers/trackers; leaving play area; physically hitting opponent
Anti-doping and GAL / MNA registration requirements
Hijab permitted; street wear subject to inspection
limitations: UUID filename on WT upload path; discoverability depends on VTKD archive link
Does not publish numerical acceleration thresholds or exact HP per damage band
Does not specify AXIS node count, IMU model, sampling rate, or accuracy
Does not specify latency budgets
Does not describe geographically distributed opponents
Does not lock a VTKD software version
Diagrams on pages 8–9 were not fully recoverable as text

sources.title: VTKD User Manual 1.3.0
exact_claims_supported: One VTKD court = two VR players
Required AXIS: 10 nodes for two players (spine, R/L thigh, R/L shin each), docks, dongles, straps
Compatible headsets: PICO 4 and PICO 4 Ultra
Dedicated Wi-Fi 6 router, internet, AX3000, 5 GHz only; access-point nodes not recommended
Physical space 40–50 sqm; 4m x 4m per player with divider
Magnetometer calibration once before event; in-game calibration during event
Surface Calibration removed from the 1.3.0 calibration path relative to 1.2.34
Players join a Game Master room on the same Wi-Fi
AXIS 2.4 GHz channels; max 10 nodes per channel recommended
System Operator and Game Master accounts required
limitations: Operator manual, not WT rules
Public HTML extraction was incomplete for later calibration/layout sections
Does not publish tracking accuracy or damage formula

sources.title: VTKD User Manual 1.2.34
exact_claims_supported: Documents Surface Calibration, Legacy Calibration, and in-game T-pose calibration
States avatar-leg offset > 1 foot is unacceptable
Documents magnetic-field failure modes of Surface Calibration
Documents GM room creation, spectator client, and 2-court maximum
Documents gameplay: 60s rounds, acceleration damage bands, stun 3s, automatic break, optional Boundary Damage
limitations: Superseded by 1.3.0 for current software
Retained because BC-015 cited it and because v1.3.0 explicitly withdraws Surface Calibration

sources.title: VTKD Game Mechanics 1.3.0
exact_claims_supported: Physical movement controls in-game avatars
AXIS nodes on spine, thighs, and shins especially for kicks
Head strikes deal double body damage; only kicks cause HP damage
Stun: punches and kicks build meter; next successful kick activates stun
Automatic break on proximity or equipment disconnect; GM must resume after disconnect
Boundary Damage is a toggleable setting
Draw criteria match the rules order
limitations: Provider mechanics page, not independently verified
Stun activation wording differs from WT Rules v4.0 Article 5.3.1
Likens VTKD to Street Fighter/Tekken; that analogy is not an Altis classification
